meta.name: Microsoft 365 Fundamentals MS-900
meta.notes: [ms-900 bulk-tag pass: added `ms-900` tag to 60 questions]

questions.question: A startup wants to avoid large upfront hardware purchases and instead pay only for the IT capacity it actually consumes each month. Which financial model best describes this approach?
questions.explanation: Cloud services bill on a consumption basis, which is treated as an operational expenditure (OpEx). CapEx involves purchasing assets up front. Depreciation and TCO are accounting concepts, not pricing models.

questions.question: An organization wants its email, file storage, and collaboration tools to be fully managed by the provider, with no servers to install or patch. Which cloud service model fits this requirement?
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 is delivered as Software as a Service (SaaS). Microsoft manages the infrastructure, platform, and applications; the customer is responsible for data and user identities. IaaS and PaaS still leave OS or runtime management to the customer.

questions.question: A regulated bank wants to keep some workloads on-premises for compliance reasons while running other workloads in the public cloud, with both connected through secure networking. Which deployment model best describes this configuration?
questions.explanation: A hybrid cloud combines on-premises (private) infrastructure with public cloud resources, connected so workloads and data can move between them. This is common for regulated industries that must keep certain data local.

questions.question: In Microsoft 365's shared responsibility model for SaaS, which task remains the customer's responsibility?
options: Maintaining the physical network hardware in Microsoft regions
Managing user accounts, access permissions, and the data they create
Replacing failed disks in Microsoft data centers
Patching the underlying operating systems of the data center servers
questions.explanation: In SaaS, the customer is always responsible for their data, identities, and access management. Microsoft handles the physical, network, host, and application layers underneath.

questions.question: A retailer experiences holiday traffic that is 10x higher than normal. They want services to automatically add capacity during peak hours and shrink afterward. Which cloud characteristic provides this behavior?
questions.explanation: Elasticity is the ability to automatically scale resources up and down to match demand. Scalability is the broader ability to grow; elasticity emphasizes automatic, dynamic adjustment.

questions.question: A company creates a distribution group for its sales team so that one email address reaches all 40 sales representatives. Which Microsoft 365 service hosts distribution groups?
questions.explanation: Distribution groups (and shared mailboxes, mail-enabled security groups) are managed in Exchange Online, which provides email and calendaring services in Microsoft 365.

questions.question: An HR department wants a centralized intranet site with news, policy documents, and links for all employees, but content should be authored by a small editorial team. Which SharePoint Online site type is best suited?
options: Channel site within a private team
Team site connected to a Microsoft 365 group
questions.explanation: Communication sites are designed to broadcast information to a wide audience with a small group of editors. Team sites are for collaboration where many members co-author content.

questions.question: A consultant frequently works offline on a plane and needs cloud files to be available locally without manually downloading each one. Which OneDrive feature provides this capability?
options: Files On-Demand with 'Always keep on this device'
questions.explanation: OneDrive Files On-Demand lets users see all cloud files in Explorer; marking them 'Always keep on this device' downloads them so they remain available offline.

questions.question: A project team wants a single workspace that combines persistent chat, file sharing, video meetings, and tabs for third-party apps. Which Microsoft 365 service best meets this need?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Teams is the hub for teamwork in Microsoft 365, integrating chat, channels, files (backed by SharePoint), online meetings, and app extensibility.

questions.question: An organization wants a curated employee experience platform inside Teams that surfaces company news, resources, and personalized dashboards. Which Microsoft Viva module addresses this?
questions.explanation: Viva Connections delivers a personalized employee gateway inside Teams, surfacing company news, resources, and a dashboard. Insights focuses on wellbeing, Learning on training, and Topics on knowledge mining.

questions.question: An IT admin must enroll new corporate Windows laptops so they auto-configure with company apps, settings, and policies the first time the user signs in. Which Microsoft service supports this scenario?
questions.explanation: Windows Autopilot, part of Microsoft Intune, allows zero-touch provisioning so a new device joins Entra ID and pulls down configurations automatically when first powered on.

questions.question: A user needs a personal, persistent Windows 11 desktop in the cloud they can access from any device, billed per user per month at a fixed rate. Which Microsoft offering best fits?
questions.explanation: Windows 365 provides a per-user, fixed-price personal Cloud PC. Azure Virtual Desktop is more flexible (multi-session, consumption-based) and aimed at IT-managed pooled or personal desktops on Azure.

questions.question: A marketing team wants to build a simple low-code app to track event registrations without writing custom backend code. Which component of the Power Platform should they use?
questions.explanation: Power Apps is the low-code application building service. Power BI is for analytics, Power Automate for workflows, and Power Pages for external-facing websites.

questions.question: An executive asks for an AI assistant that drafts emails in Outlook, summarizes Teams meetings, and creates PowerPoint outlines from a Word document. Which Microsoft 365 add-on provides these capabilities?
questions.explanation: Copilot for Microsoft 365 is the AI assistant integrated across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and other apps, generating content based on Microsoft Graph data with enterprise data protection.

questions.question: A developer wants a single REST API to read Outlook calendar, OneDrive files, and Teams chats with one access token. Which Microsoft service exposes this unified API?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Graph is the unified REST endpoint that gives developers access to data across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows, and Enterprise Mobility + Security.

questions.question: An organization wants to track how employees adopt Microsoft 365 services (Teams meetings, OneDrive sharing, Outlook usage) to drive change-management initiatives. Which feature in the admin center surfaces this information?
questions.explanation: Adoption Score (formerly Productivity Score) provides aggregated insights into how the organization uses Microsoft 365 services and where adoption can be improved.

questions.question: A team wants to co-author a portable component containing a task list and table that can live inside a Teams chat, an Outlook email, and a Word document at the same time. Which Microsoft 365 capability provides this?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Loop components are live, portable pieces of content (tables, lists, paragraphs) that synchronize wherever they are pasted across Teams, Outlook, Word for the web, and Whiteboard.

questions.question: A small clinic wants customers to self-book appointments with specific staff members and receive automatic email confirmations. Which Microsoft 365 service provides this booking page?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Bookings is the appointment-scheduling service that gives external customers a self-service booking page integrated with staff calendars.

questions.question: An IT manager wants only managed corporate phones that are enrolled and compliant to access Microsoft 365 mail. Which Microsoft service enforces device enrollment and compliance policies?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Intune (part of Microsoft Endpoint Manager) provides MDM and MAM, allowing administrators to enroll devices and enforce compliance policies before granting access to corporate resources.

questions.question: A sales rep using a personal phone needs to read corporate email but the company refuses to fully manage the device. Which Intune feature lets the company protect data inside the Outlook app without controlling the whole device?
options: Mobile Application Management (MAM) with app protection policies
questions.explanation: App protection policies (MAM-WE — without enrollment) let admins control corporate data inside specific apps such as Outlook, OneDrive, and Teams without enrolling the entire personal device.

questions.question: Which two Microsoft 365 components are typically used together to host video content for the entire organization, with security trimming and integration into Teams?
options: Microsoft Stream (on SharePoint) backed by SharePoint and OneDrive
questions.explanation: Microsoft Stream (on SharePoint) stores and streams videos using SharePoint and OneDrive as the storage layer, inheriting their permissions and search.

questions.question: An organization wants employees to ask company-wide questions and get answers from senior leaders in a Yammer-style social network. Which Viva module supports this?
questions.explanation: Viva Engage is the rebranded experience built on Yammer, designed for community building, leadership Q&A, and storyline posts inside Microsoft 365.

questions.question: An organization wants to assign and track Word, Excel, and PowerPoint training courses from LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft Learn, and internal SharePoint sources directly inside Teams. Which Viva module fits?
questions.explanation: Viva Learning aggregates training content from multiple providers and surfaces it inside Microsoft Teams so employees can find, share, and complete courses.

questions.question: A Microsoft 365 admin wants to enforce passwordless sign-in using a mobile authenticator app for all users. Which Microsoft service implements this identity capability?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) is the cloud identity provider for Microsoft 365 and supports passwordless authentication methods such as Microsoft Authenticator, FIDO2 keys, and Windows Hello.

questions.question: An organization wants users to be challenged with multifactor authentication only when they sign in from outside the corporate network or from a non-compliant device. Which Entra ID feature enforces this rule?
questions.explanation: Conditional Access policies evaluate signals such as user, location, device state, and risk to grant, block, or require MFA. They are the primary tool for context-aware access in Entra ID.

questions.question: A security architect is told to assume that any user, device, or network could be compromised at any moment, and to verify every request explicitly. Which security model is being described?
questions.explanation: Zero Trust is built on three principles: verify explicitly, use least-privilege access, and assume breach. It treats all access requests as untrusted regardless of network location.

questions.question: Which Microsoft Defender XDR component is specifically designed to detect lateral movement and credential theft against on-premises Active Directory domain controllers?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Defender for Identity (formerly Azure ATP) monitors on-premises Active Directory traffic to detect attacks such as Pass-the-Hash, Pass-the-Ticket, and Golden Ticket.

questions.question: A company wants to scan inbound email attachments and links for phishing and malware before users click them. Which Microsoft Defender component provides Safe Attachments and Safe Links?
questions.explanation: Defender for Office 365 protects email and collaboration tools (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive) using features like Safe Links, Safe Attachments, and anti-phishing policies.

questions.question: An admin wants visibility into shadow IT — that is, unsanctioned cloud apps employees use from corporate devices — and the ability to block risky ones. Which Microsoft service provides this CASB capability?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is Microsoft's CASB; it discovers shadow IT, evaluates app risk, and lets admins govern or block unsanctioned SaaS applications.

questions.question: An information protection team wants to apply labels such as 'Confidential' or 'Public' to Word documents so encryption and watermarks are automatically enforced when the file is shared. Which Microsoft Purview feature provides this?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels apply classification, encryption, watermarking, and protection settings to documents and emails wherever they travel.

questions.question: A company must prevent users from emailing files containing credit card numbers to external recipients. Which Microsoft Purview capability enforces this rule across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies inspect content for sensitive information types (such as credit card numbers) and block, warn, or audit attempts to share them.

questions.question: Lawyers need to place certain mailboxes and SharePoint sites on legal hold and search across them for case-related content. Which Microsoft Purview feature is designed for this workflow?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Standard or Premium) enables legal teams to identify, hold, search, and export content from Microsoft 365 to support investigations and legal cases.

questions.question: An organization wants to make sure that even Microsoft engineers cannot access the tenant data without explicit customer approval. Which Microsoft 365 feature provides this assurance?
questions.explanation: Customer Lockbox requires explicit customer approval before a Microsoft support engineer can access the customer's content to troubleshoot a service request, providing an additional layer of access control.

questions.question: An admin wants a numeric measurement of the Microsoft 365 tenant's security posture and recommended actions to improve it. Which Microsoft service provides this score?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Secure Score, available in the Microsoft Defender portal, provides a numeric measurement of the tenant's security posture along with prioritized improvement actions.

questions.question: A compliance officer needs a dashboard that maps the tenant's controls to regulations such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and HIPAA, with improvement actions and a compliance score. Which Microsoft service provides this?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager provides a compliance score and assessments mapped to regulations and standards, with recommended improvement actions for both Microsoft-managed and customer-managed controls.

questions.question: An auditor asks for Microsoft's latest SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001 certificate for Microsoft 365. Where can the customer download these documents directly?
options: Microsoft 365 admin center → Health → Service health
questions.explanation: The Microsoft Service Trust Portal is the central location to download independent audit reports (SOC 1/2/3, ISO certificates), Microsoft's compliance documentation, and trust resources.

questions.question: An admin needs to grant a user the Global Administrator role only for a 4-hour change window, requiring approval and audit logging. Which Entra ID feature enables this just-in-time elevation?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM) provides just-in-time, time-bound, approval-based activation of privileged roles, with full auditing — included in Entra ID P2.

questions.question: An organization with 200 employees needs Microsoft 365 desktop apps, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune device management at a low per-user price. Which plan is the most cost-effective fit?
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 Business Premium is targeted at organizations up to 300 seats and bundles Office desktop apps, Exchange/Teams/SharePoint, Intune, and Defender for Business — typically the most cost-effective for SMBs.

questions.question: Which Microsoft 365 Enterprise plan is required to obtain Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 2, Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium), Power BI Pro, and Teams Phone all in a single license?
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 E5 is the top enterprise SKU and bundles advanced security (Defender for Endpoint Plan 2, Defender for Identity), Purview Premium, Power BI Pro, and Teams Phone.

questions.question: A retailer wants licenses for warehouse and store staff who only need email, web/mobile Office apps, and basic Teams chat — they share kiosks and don't need full desktop Office. Which plan family is designed for this audience?
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 F1 and F3 are the frontline worker SKUs, priced for shift workers who primarily use shared devices and need essential collaboration without full desktop Office.

questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes the difference between Microsoft 365 E3 and Office 365 E3?
options: Office 365 E3 includes Windows 11 while Microsoft 365 E3 does not
There is no difference; the two SKUs are identical
Microsoft 365 E3 is per device while Office 365 E3 is per user
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 plans bundle Office 365 + Windows Enterprise + Enterprise Mobility + Security (EMS). Office 365 plans contain only the Office 365 productivity stack. Enterprise Mobility + Security E3, and Office 365 E3 in one bundle

questions.question: A customer wants to lower their per-month cost on Microsoft 365 E3 and is willing to commit for 12 months instead of paying month-to-month. Which billing option provides a discount in exchange for that commitment?
questions.explanation: Microsoft 365 commercial plans offer a discount when customers commit to an annual term (paid monthly or upfront) compared to the higher month-to-month rate.

questions.question: An enterprise has 500 Microsoft 365 licenses and wants Microsoft engineers to help them plan and deploy Teams, SharePoint, and Intune at no extra cost. Which Microsoft program offers this onboarding assistance?
questions.explanation: FastTrack is a customer success service included with eligible Microsoft 365 subscriptions (typically 150+ licenses) that helps customers plan, deploy, and adopt Microsoft 365 services.

questions.question: Where should an admin look for upcoming Microsoft 365 features that are in preview, rolling out, or recently launched, with target dates and categories?
questions.explanation: The Microsoft 365 Roadmap (microsoft.com/microsoft-365/roadmap) lists features in development, rolling out, and launched, including target dates and the products affected.

questions.question: Microsoft publishes uptime commitments for Microsoft 365 services. What is the financially backed uptime SLA for most Microsoft 365 services such as Exchange Online and SharePoint Online?
questions.explanation: Most Microsoft 365 services have a financially backed SLA of 99.9% uptime. Customers can claim service credits if Microsoft fails to meet that uptime in a given month.

questions.question: An admin wants real-time information about ongoing service incidents affecting their Microsoft 365 tenant (for example, an Outlook on the web outage). Which tool should they consult?
options: Service health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center
questions.explanation: The Service health dashboard in the Microsoft 365 admin center reports current incidents and advisories affecting the tenant, including impact, status, and remediation timelines.

questions.question: An enterprise customer with thousands of seats wants a dedicated Customer Success Account Manager and a contractual response time for Sev A incidents under 1 hour. Which Microsoft support offering meets this?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Unified Support (which replaced Premier Support) provides enterprise-level proactive services, a Customer Success Account Manager, and contractual response times for the highest-severity incidents.

questions.question: Which Microsoft service is a cloud-native SIEM and SOAR solution that ingests signals from Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and third-party sources to detect and respond to threats at scale?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Sentinel is the cloud-native Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) service in Microsoft's security portfolio.

questions.question: An organization wants HR managers to be alerted when employees download abnormally large amounts of data shortly before resigning. Which Microsoft Purview solution targets this scenario?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management uses signals such as data exfiltration, sensitive content downloads, and HR system events to surface potentially risky user activities while protecting privacy.

questions.question: Two business divisions inside the same tenant must be prevented from communicating in Teams to avoid conflicts of interest. Which Microsoft Purview feature enforces this segregation?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview Information Barriers create policies that prevent specified groups of users from communicating or collaborating in Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive — commonly used in finance and legal sectors.

questions.question: Which Microsoft 365 feature lets administrators automatically delete user mailboxes and SharePoint content after a defined retention period to meet records management policies?
options: Microsoft Purview retention policies and labels
questions.explanation: Microsoft Purview retention policies and retention labels keep or delete content automatically across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams based on defined retention rules.

questions.question: An organization is migrating a CRM workload to a public cloud provider that exposes virtual machines, virtual networks, and storage that the customer manages. Which cloud service model is being consumed?
questions.explanation: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) provides virtualized compute, storage, and networking. The customer remains responsible for the operating system, runtime, and applications.

questions.question: An IT manager wants to provide a managed Windows 11 multi-session environment in Azure where multiple users share the same VM, paying only for the compute they consume. Which Microsoft offering best fits?
questions.explanation: Azure Virtual Desktop supports Windows 11 multi-session and is billed on Azure consumption (compute, storage, network). Windows 365 Cloud PC is per-user, dedicated, fixed-price.

questions.question: An admin is asked which Microsoft 365 service provides shared mailboxes that don't require their own license, as long as the mailbox is under 50 GB and used to receive email by multiple users. Which service provides shared mailboxes?
questions.explanation: Exchange Online provides shared mailboxes. They do not require their own user license as long as the mailbox is 50 GB or smaller and is not used as a personal mailbox.

questions.question: A company wants to give employees a way to record their personal goals, key results, and progress aligned to business objectives, with check-ins and dashboards. Which Microsoft Viva module addresses this?
questions.explanation: Viva Goals provides OKR (Objectives and Key Results) management — letting teams align goals, track progress, and integrate with Microsoft 365 tools. The other modules focus on different employee experience scenarios.

questions.question: An organization needs to obtain phone numbers and PSTN dial-in / dial-out capability for Microsoft Teams users. Which add-on must be licensed?
options: Microsoft Teams Phone (with a Calling Plan or Direct Routing)
questions.explanation: Microsoft Teams Phone enables enterprise voice in Teams. To make and receive PSTN calls, customers add a Microsoft Calling Plan, Operator Connect, or use Direct Routing with their own SBC.

questions.question: Which combination of capabilities is the primary differentiator of Microsoft 365 E5 over Microsoft 365 E3?
options: OneDrive for Business storage and Teams chat
Office desktop apps and Exchange Online
questions.explanation: M365 E3 already includes Office, Windows, and EMS E3. E5 adds advanced security (Defender for Endpoint P2, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud Apps), advanced compliance, Power BI Pro, and Teams Phone. Defender for Identity), advanced compliance (Purview Premium), Power BI Pro, and Teams Phone

questions.question: Which authentication method is considered the strongest passwordless option for Microsoft Entra ID, providing phishing-resistant credentials backed by hardware?
questions.explanation: FIDO2 security keys (and Windows Hello for Business and certificate-based authentication) provide phishing-resistant, hardware-backed passwordless authentication. SMS and email OTPs are weaker and not phishing-resistant.

questions.question: Microsoft 365 customers worried about regulatory compliance can review independently audited reports and certifications. Which Microsoft 365 feature provides these reports along with trust documents and white papers in a single portal?
questions.explanation: The Microsoft Service Trust Portal centralizes audit reports (SOC, ISO, PCI), GDPR documentation, white papers, and other trust resources to support customer compliance assessments.

questions.question: An organization wants to give employees Copilot for Microsoft 365 to help draft documents and summarize meetings. Which licensing prerequisite must be met before purchasing the Copilot add-on?
options: Customers must purchase Power BI Pro for every user
Customers must run Exchange Server on-premises
Customers must already have Microsoft 365 F1 or higher
Customers must already have an eligible Microsoft 365 plan such as Business Standard/Premium or Enterprise E3/E5
questions.explanation: Copilot for Microsoft 365 is a per-user add-on that requires an eligible base subscription such as Microsoft 365 Business Standard, Business Premium, E3, E5, or A3/A5 for faculty.
